note: File: studies/rlneurons/results/anatomy/judge-01/labels.json (committed, read in place). Kept: model == 'base', planted_at null, kind not in {planted, shuffled}; anatomy_judge.py names both kinds as controls. That leaves the 60 real base items. Main problem: in anatomy_judge.py (prep, line 107) answer_from_problem is not a judge flag. It is the index of the source problem j and is set only on 'shuffled' controls, where a right answer of problem j is shown under problem i. On every real item it is null. Under the recipe as written (null counts negative, an int is not boolean true), the main number is fixed by the data layout and says nothing about the mechanism. The judge's labels are in passA/passB.label (slip/wrong_plan/misread/format/mismatch/unclear), and none of them is 'answer from problem'. alt_measured: only kind 'planted' is dropped (shuffled kept), and any non-null, non-false value counts as positive. Its count comes only from the shuffled controls, so it is not a measure of the mechanism either. Unit 'fraction of problems' is really a fraction of items (at most one per problem).

Same file and logic as k=1 with model == 'rl': the 30 real RL items after dropping the planted and shuffled controls. The same caveat applies: answer_from_problem is the shuffled control's source-problem index (anatomy_judge.py line 107) and is null on every real item, so the main number is set by the data layout, not by the judge. Refuted_by is 'measured above 0.10', applied to the main number. alt_measured keeps the shuffled controls and counts any non-null value as positive, so it counts only control items.

Files: studies/rlneurons/results/day1_3/math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl and math500_rl-01/rows.jsonl (committed). Prompts: runs/theory-rows/frustea-1114-180849-456c/answers.jsonl if present, otherwise fetched with `modal volume get iterate-runs frustea-1114-180849-456c/answers.jsonl runs/theory-tests/...`. That file is the base min-p 0.1 cell and the recipe uses it only for prompt text. Filters: attempt == 0, cap_hit is False, score_v3 == 0, extracted_v3 a str of length > 0 (not stripped). Problem numbers: the prompt of the first row per problem_index in file order, all \d+(?:\.\d+)? matches, then any number string found in every prompt is dropped (the intersection of the per-prompt sets, so instruction-header digits fall out). Normalization: strip whitespace, '$' and ','; remove one trailing suffix, checking ^{\circ}, ^\circ, \%, % in that order; numeric iff ^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$. Match: |abs(answer) - number| <= 1e-9. Shares are per sample, not per problem, despite the stated unit. A zero denominator prints not_computable. Ambiguity, and alt_measured: the prompt regex splits thousands-separated numbers ('1,000' gives 1 and 000) while the answer normalization removes commas, so an answer 1000 does not match '1,000' in the main reading. alt_measured first joins comma-grouped numbers in the prompts (1,000 -> 1000) and keeps the rest identical. Other things that could shift the number: LaTeX digits in prompts (\frac{1}{2} gives 1 and 2) and small numbers such as 1 or 2, which make chance matches common. Answers like '\frac{1}{2}' or '\text{...}' are non-numeric and excluded. The '^\circ' suffix is removed once, so '30^\circ\%' stays non-numeric.

Base share computed exactly as in k=3 (same files, filters, prompt numbers, normalization). Gold share: for each problem_index the gold of the first attempt == 0 row of math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl in file order, normalized with the same rules. Only numeric golds count, matched by abs value against that problem's numbers, and problems without a prompt row are excluded. Statistic = base share (per sample) minus gold share (per problem). The two denominators differ in unit, so problems with several wrong samples weigh more on the base side. alt_measured: the same comma-joining prompt reading as in k=3, applied to both shares. Golds with LaTeX (\frac, \sqrt, \text{}, units) are non-numeric and excluded, so the gold share comes from integer and decimal golds only. Refuted_by: main number below 0.05.
